s_sub: BombVault's activity log as a real, native tile on the Unraid dashboard.
s_url_hint: Address of your BombVault WebUI, e.g. https://192.168.20.51:3443 — a self-signed certificate on the LAN is fine.
s_token_hint: Create it in BombVault → Settings → System → Dashboard widget. It grants read-only access to the activity log; the token never leaves the server.
s_tile_hint: The "BombVault Activity" tile appears on the Dashboard automatically (middle column). Hide, move or collapse it with Unraid's own tile controls — the log body stays dark on every theme, like a terminal.
